canada.title: Inquest into death of police-involved death of Jamal Francique shown videos from after shooting
canada.summary: The inquest into the death of a Black man shot by police in Mississauga in early 2020 is watching videos showing the officers around his wrecked car after the shooting.

canada.title: PAL Airlines pilots are voting to go on strike  — potentially stopping flights next month
canada.summary: After failed negotiations with their employer, PAL Airlines pilots are voting to go on strike — potentially stopping flights next month.

canada.title: Striking Selkirk steelworkers reject another deal, reaching impasse as arbitration looms
canada.summary: Striking workers at a steel recycling plant in Selkirk, Man., have rejected the employer's latest offer. Meanwhile, some 220 school support workers in the Lord Selkirk School Division have voted in favour of a new contract.

canada.title: Inuit organizations to take over administering federal Inuit Child First Initiative
canada.summary: The Inuit Child First Initiative provides Inuit children with access to health, social and educational products and services regardless of where in Canada they live. Now, Inuit organizations are getting ready to take on administering the program for their own regions.

canada.title: Proposed flavoured vape ban 'years in the making,' says N.L.'s top doctor
canada.summary: Newfoundland and Labrador will give retailers at least six months from when the current sitting of the House of Assembly wraps up, but intends to see flavoured vape products removed from store shelves.

canada.title: Mother, man face charges in three-year-old’s opioid death in Edmonton
canada.summary: EDMONTON - Police say an Edmonton woman and her partner are facing charges after her three-year-old daughter died from poisoning by a potent opioid.

canada.title: EverWind says Cape Breton AI data centre project on track despite concerns
canada.summary: A representative of EverWind, the company behind a massive data centre project in Cape Breton, says everything is moving ahead as planned.
canada.outlet: Global News, Halifax Examiner, CBC News

canada.title: Saskatchewan RCMP make more than 100 arrests in ‘intelligence-driven enforcement’
canada.summary: A targeted enforcement blitz in Pelican Narrows, Sask., resulted in more than 100 arrests, as well as the seizure of 10 firearms and drugs, according to the RCMP.

canada.title: Police arrest roommate of 67-year-old man killed in Brossard
canada.summary: Police arrested a 44-year-old man after his 67-year-old roommate died in a homicide in Brossard, south of Montreal, Tuesday night.

canada.title: They paddled and portaged 1,700 km through Canada’s largest peatland. This is what they learned
canada.summary: David and Leah Jackson's 55-day canoe trip took them deep into Ontario's Ring of Fire mining region, where a critical minerals rush is gathering momentum. Here's what what they learned

canada.title: Quebec Bar Association wants new hotline, tax credit to improve access to justice
canada.summary: The professional order of lawyers in Quebec is proposing a new hotline as part of a range of measures to make legal services more accessible to members of the public.

canada.title: Union bracing for layoffs amid B.C. Conservative plan to pause Massey Tunnel replacement
canada.summary: A union representing crews on the George Massey Tunnel replacement project says workers are bracing for layoffs as they wait to see if the incoming B.C. Conservative government switches plans to a bridge instead.

canada.title: Canada's national emergency alert system will sound off Wednesday for testing
canada.summary: Canada's National Public Alerting System is running tests of its Alert Ready system Wednesday across all provinces and territories. Alert Ready delivers alerts about critical events such as tornadoes, flooding, fires and Amber alerts.

canada.title: Winnipeg police believe more victims were likely targeted in fake jewelry scams
canada.summary: Winnipeg police say they're looking for more victims after a number of elderly people were targeted in a fake jewelry scam last summer, but add a couple charged previously have been "removed from Canada" and their charges have been stayed.

canada.title: 21 arrested, 112 charges laid in Toronto tow truck organized crime probe
canada.summary: Toronto police say 21 people have been arrested and 112 charges laid in a major organized crime investigation involving the GTA towing industry.

canada.title: Snowfall interrupts Saskatchewan's relatively balmy November
canada.summary: Winter is finally arriving in Saskatchewan, starting with a snowfall warning for Maple Creek. Environment and Climate Change Canada issued the warning Tuesday afternoon, saying the snow is expected to begin overnight.

canada.title: Explosion, fire destroy building in downtown Glace Bay and sends 14 to hospital
canada.summary: An explosion and large fire in downtown Glace Bay, N.S. has destroyed a building and sent 14 people to hospital.

canada.title: Calgary to explore new rules for data centres but temporary pause will go to public hearing
canada.summary: The move comes as a rezoning application is under review at city hall that would make way for a large-scale data centre in northeast Calgary.
canada.outlet: Global News, Halifax Examiner, CBC News
